analysis.reason: 직전 매수 판단 이후 RSI 58.9까지 상승하며 중립 구간 안착 확인. MACD 히스토그램 또한 개선세 지속되며 상승 추세 강화. 5일 저가 1,558,000원 대비 20일 저가 1,440,000원으로 Higher Low 패턴 형성하며 회복 신호 강화. 현재가 1,864,000원, 스윙 지지선 1,855,000원 근접하며 매수 진입 유효 구간.
analysis.reasonEn: Following the previous buy decision, RSI rose to 58.9, confirming consolidation in the neutral zone. The MACD histogram also continued its improvement, strengthening the uptrend. A Higher Low pattern formed with the 5-day low at 1,558,000 KRW and the 20-day low at 1,440,000 KRW, reinforcing the recovery signal. The current price of 1,864,000 KRW is near the swing support of 1,855,000 KRW, making it a valid entry zone.
analysis.weeklyConflict: 주봉 RSI 55.6으로 중립 구간이나, 일봉 RSI 58.5로 상승 추세 유지. 주봉 MACD 히스토그램은 음수이나 개선 중. 일봉 기준 우선.
analysis.weeklyConflictEn: Weekly RSI at 55.6 in neutral zone, but daily RSI at 58.5 maintains uptrend. Weekly MACD histogram is negative but improving. Daily basis takes precedence.

[Volume & Conclusion]

· Current phase diagnosis (Uptrend): Buy entry conditions met with RSI neutral consolidation and continued MACD improvement
